tags: A stage film toned in two inks
A line-up poster that checks for clashes
The booking fee shown before you hold
features: The name, the dates and the ticket price are all on the first screen, over the stage film
The line-up is a printed poster you tap to build your weekend, and it stamps any clash
The slip underneath draws each night hour by hour with the overlap marked, so nobody misses the act they came for
Ticket tiers show live availability and the booking fee before you hold, the thing that loses festival sales at checkout
name: SIGNAL 2027
short: A festival website where the line-up poster builds your weekend and warns you about clashes.
long: Signal opens on the stage film with the festival name set edge to edge. The line-up is a printed poster: tap the acts you want and it stamps any clash, while the slip underneath draws your nights hour by hour. Tickets show the booking fee before you hold them.
proves: Bold, and still easy to use.
story: The bold one, rebuilt around the crowd. Everything on it helps someone decide to go: who is on, when, where, and what it costs.
